prompt: Lectures were used in the past with many students. With modern technology available for education, there is no justification for this way of teaching. To what extent do you agree or disagree ?
essay:
These days, online platforms such as Udemy, LinkedIn and YouTube have taken the place of classroom classes. Children can enrol in live classes as well as recorded lectures in just one click by sitting at their homes. However, some people still believe that the old way of teaching was much better than the modern type of education system. In this essay, I will discuss about about this change and its impact on student life.

To commence with, nowadays, students have multiple options to study either attending lectures in classrooms or online via various online platforms provided by  educational institutions. In other words, Universities are providing feasibility to students that they can either attend classroom or attend live lectures through various mediums set up online. For example, during COVID-19 times, colleges shared Microsoft Teams links to  classroom instruction so that students could attend those classes directly from their homes because schools were closed due to the pandemic.

Furthermore,  individuals these days can directly enrol themselves in online study platforms directly from their Mobile and Laptops. To explicate, people have an option to directly subscribe to any courses they like instead of paying  for live classes at coaching centres. Moreover, these courses are  much more reasonable than classroom sessions and thus save time and money. For instance, I have purchased a subscription plan for the IELTS test series from one of the websites for just $11 and this saves me huge fees for the IELTS course, In addition to it, I can access this course by sitting at home and saving my commuting time.

To conclude, I totally agree that modern technologies have brought a revolutionary change in  teaching way and provided more access and feasibility to  students. In this way, they can save dollars and get quality education at just fingertips.
